'''Henris Octavian''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was assigned to take over stewardship of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the wake of the Imperial [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]].<ref name="Game" />
